content.value: Consider a triangle which has three vertices as $\mathsf { P } _ { 1 } ( 1 , 2 ) , \mathsf { P } _ { 2 } ( 5 , 0 )$ and $\mathtt { P 3 } ( 3 , 4 )$ . A scan line S (22) go through it and intersection points are $\mathtt { P 4 } ( 3 , 1 )$ and $\mathbb { P } _ { 5 } ( 4 , 1 )$ . Inside the triangle there is a point $\mathbb { P } ( 3 . 5 , 1 )$ on scan line. Normals for three vertices are $\mathrm { N } _ { 1 } ( 0 , 1 , 0 ) , \mathrm { N } _ { 2 } ( 0 , 0 , 1 )$ and $\mathrm { \widetilde { N } } _ { 3 } ( 0 , 0 . 7 , 0 . 7 )$ We also have the following values: $\mathrm { L } { = } ( 0 , 0 . 7 , 0 . 7 ) , \quad \mathrm { v } { = } ( 0 , 0 , 1 )$ $\dot { \mathrm { K _ { a } } } \mathrm { = } 0 . 1 , \dot { \mathrm { I _ { a } } } \mathrm { = } \dot { 0 . 5 } , \mathrm { K _ { d } } \mathrm { = } 0 . 5 , \mathrm { K _ { \it s } } \mathrm { = } 0 . 2 , \mathrm { n _ { \it s } } \mathrm { = } 1 , \mathrm { I _ { \mathrm { L } } } \mathrm { = } 0 . 6$ , where symbols denote usual meanings. Find Intensity $\mathrm { I } _ { 4 } , \mathrm { I } _ { 5 } ,$ and ${ \tt I } _ { \tt p }$ on scan line with Gouraud shading.
